Properties.Description: Supply Checkout api stack (stateless)
Properties.Name: /supply-checkout/prod/api/stack

Properties.Description: Execution role for the data function
Products and sheets for the app (the data API)
Execution role for the auth function
Sign-in sessions: code exchange, refresh and sign-out with an HttpOnly cookie
Execution role for the account function
The signed-in user's teams and invites; creates teams, manages members and invites, and accepts invites
Assumed by the data function per request, tagged with the team; reaches only that team's items
Assumed by the account function per request, tagged with the user and at most one team, invitee, member and invited address; reaches only those partitions
Execution role for the billing function
Starts Stripe Checkout for a team's owner (ADR 0009)
Assumed by the billing function per request, tagged with the team and its Stripe customer: reads the team, and links the customer
Execution role for the webhook function
Stripe's webhook: verifies each event's signature and queues it (ADR 0009)
Execution role for the worker-entry function
Applies queued Stripe events to teams' plans, seats and status, and emails owners (ADR 0009)
Assumed by the billing worker per event, tagged with the event, its Stripe customer and the customer's team: the event's records, the link, and the team's billing attributes
Supply Checkout data and sign-in API (docs/api/openapi.yaml)
Properties.Name: supply-checkout-prod

Properties.Description: Execution role for the ops function
Platform operators: teams, comps and the operator audit (ADR 0015)
Assumed by the ops function per request (ADR 0015): the operators' index, one team's comp attributes, and append-only operator audit
Execution role for the reopen function
Reopens a closed team for the ops function, audited (ADR 0015)
Assumed by the operator reopen function per request, tagged with the team (ADR 0015): that team's closure fields, and its operator audit
